title: On Upsetting the whole tray in one movement
subtitle: 情感心理 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）
meta: 主题语境：情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）　|　核心词汇：upset　|　正文 355 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 upset 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1961 the herder ① upset the whole tray in one movement on the same day, and every neighbour in the pasture said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three winters on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the herder ② upsets the whole tray in one movement before dawn without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ upset the whole tray in one movement at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ upset the whole tray in one movement before — a line in the ledger for December 1955 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Upsetting the whole tray in one movement on the same day, the herder said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the rope at the far pen, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ upset everybody with one question before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Upset everybody with one question at once and never mention it again.

By 1968 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the ledger, and a new neighbour from the next pasture ⑧ upsets everybody with one question on the same day every winter without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the pen, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ upset the whole tray in one movement again when nobody else would.

⑩ To upset the whole tray in one movement, my mother said in 1973, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the pasture remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the pasture forgets, somebody upsets the whole tray in one movement before dawn again and somebody must upset the whole tray in one movement on the same day all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 打翻（一般过去式 upset the whole tray in one movement：1961 年牧人头一回这样做，当天就）
B. v. 打翻（一般现在 upsets the whole tray in one movement：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 打翻（不定式 to upset the whole tray in one movement：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 打翻（过去完成时 had upset the whole tray in one movement：1955 年十二月的牧群台账上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 打翻（动名词 upsetting the whole tray in one movement 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 使心烦（upset everybody with one question：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去使心烦一个问题让所有人都不安）
G. v. 使心烦（upset everybody with one question：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 打翻（后段两处：新来的邻人照例 upsets everybody with one question，而母亲又一次 upset the whole tray in one movement）

answers.why: upset 意为“打翻”，1961 年牧人当天就打翻一下把整盘东西打翻，那是牧场里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 upset。
upset 意为“打翻”，自那以后牧人天没亮就把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 upsets。
upset 意为“打翻”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯打翻一下把整盘东西打翻”，此处为不定式 to upset the whole tray in one movement。
upset 意为“打翻”，牧群台账里 十二月 那行字说明早在 1968 年之前就有人打翻过，故用过去完成时 had upset。
upset 意为“打翻”，牧人说“打翻一下把整盘东西打翻这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 upsetting the whole tray in one movement 作主语。
upset 意为“使心烦”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去使心烦一个问题让所有人都不安”，should ever 之后用原形 upset everybody with one question。
upset 意为“使心烦”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻使心烦一个问题让所有人都不安（upset everybody with one question at once），以后再也不要提起。
upset 意为“打翻”，新来的邻人每个冬天都照例使心烦一个问题让所有人都不安，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 upsets。
upset 意为“打翻”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次当天就打翻一下把整盘东西打翻，用一般过去式 upset 叙述。
upset 意为“打翻”，结尾那句是母亲 1973 年的话：要打翻一下把整盘东西打翻，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和牧场记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 upset 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1961 the herder upset the whole tray in one movement on the same day, and nobody in the pasture forgot it.
Even now the herder upsets the whole tray in one movement before dawn whenever the pasture asks.
Upsetting the whole tray in one movement on the same day, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever upset everybody with one question before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new neighbour from the next pasture upsets everybody with one question on the same day every winter, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother upset the whole tray in one movement again, and the pasture remembered that half.
